narratives.Description: bug(scope): derived clauses never get test evidence, so through-merge cannot complete the brief
narratives.Overview:
1. Derived acceptance clauses may leave buildClause with artifact_path null. Promote ok/unchanged does not discharge bind for pathless clauses. Before stamp, every clause that must be proven by a test must go through an explicit bind step that writes a non-blank artifact_path taken only from approved declared file_scope (or an explicit human bind onto that surface). Do not lift a filesystem path from issue body or comment text (#3835). Empty file_scope remains a silent no-op for bind; it does not invent a path. "Must be proven by a test" is the human/bind selector, not a promote auto-classifier.
2. scope:stamp-evidence must be able to record kind:test evidence onto a clause that already has a non-blank artifact_path inside approved file_scope. The production writer is stampMatchAnyFileEvidence / resolveMatchAnyFilePointer (shared null-on-empty-or-blank gate with the exact helper). A patch that only changes resolveAllowedTestPointer / stampDeclaredTestEvidence does not close this issue.
3. Unbound clauses stay fail-closed (#4385). A merge SHA still does not satisfy smoke, UAT, deploy, or observed behavior (#3240). #4732 stays the already-bound-only neighbor; it is not the fix surface for null-path derivation.

Checked `git rev-parse HEAD` equals `ef922d2a636a86e81dfee7e5d34d19ab9d8fec2a`. Pin reads used `git show` at that SHA. Re-ran focused vitest over `acceptance-evidence`, `clauses`, `stamp-evidence`, and `clause-file-scope-bind` filters for the #3835 / #4732 / null-path / stampMatchAny anchors: 20 passed.

## Production stamp verb uses matchAny, not resolveAllowedTestPointer
sharpens-framing
Evidence: At the dispatch SHA, `packages/core/src/scope/stamp-evidence.ts` `stampEvidenceOnBrief` calls `stampMatchAnyFileEvidence`, which resolves through `resolveMatchAnyFilePointer`. `resolveAllowedTestPointer` is the exact-member helper used only by `stampDeclaredTestEvidence`. Both helpers return null when `file_scope` is empty or `artifact_path` is blank (`acceptance-evidence.ts`).
Failure mode: A later lean that patches only `resolveAllowedTestPointer` / `stampDeclaredTestEvidence` leaves the live `scope:stamp-evidence` path untouched, so through-merge still writes zero evidence on null-path derived clauses.
Disposition: Keep the null-on-empty-or-blank failure in the target; name the production writer as `stampMatchAnyFileEvidence` / `resolveMatchAnyFilePointer` (or say both stamp writers share the gate) before bind.

## Pathless derived clauses stay unbound after promote even with file_scope
sharpens-framing
Evidence: `buildClause` always returns `artifact_path: null` (`clauses.ts`). `bindClausesToDeclaredScope` returns ok/unchanged when declared scope is empty. With a non-empty `file_scope`, `bindStoredOrTokens` still returns `{ ok: true, path: null }` when clause text names no matchAny file token. The #3550 active brief at this SHA has `acceptance.source_rung: derived`, five clauses all `artifact_path: null`, no `plan.metadata.swarm` / `file_scope`, and clause-keyed items with no `x-directive/evidence`, while `packages/core/src/product-first-done-gate/sentence-floor.test.ts` exists on the same tree. `scope:complete` runs `evaluateAcceptanceEvidenceGate` then `evaluateScopeCompleteAcceptanceWalk` (`transition.ts`); `walkOne` returns `unverifiable` / `no artifact path bound` before any file read.
Failure mode: A remedy that only teaches stamp to invent a pointer from a landed PR test, without a declared bind onto `artifact_path` under approved `file_scope`, can pass a hand `kind:test` item stamp and still fail verify:ac / complete on unbound clauses. Filling `file_scope` alone does not bind behavioral clauses that name no path.
Disposition: Scope the hole as derivation-null plus promote-bind leave-null for pathless clauses plus stamp refusal on blank path; keep #3835 (no path lift from issue/comment text), #4385 (unbound fail closed), and #3240 (merge SHA is not smoke/UAT/deploy/observed evidence) as hard constraints on any bind lean.

## #4732 already-bound-only stamp is in force
footnote
Evidence: `stampDeclaredTestEvidence` / `stampMatchAnyFileEvidence` skip `no-allowed-pointer` when path is blank; comments and tests cite #4732 as not inventing rows and not stamping inside the evidence gate. The #3550 instance never reaches an already-bound clause.
Failure mode: Treating #4732 as the missing through-merge closer overstates that slice.
Disposition: No change to the target causal chain; keep #4732 as the already-bound-only neighbor, not the fix surface for null-path derivation.

## Injection / swarm lens on evidence binding
footnote
Evidence: `buildClause` docs and walk gate (#3835) refuse lifting a filesystem path from untrusted issue/comment prose; stamp writers also refuse PR paths, verify_commands, and comment prose. `file_scope` is the approved read surface (#3145 / #4008).
Failure mode: A closer that binds `artifact_path` from comment text, or stamps a PR-added test outside approved `file_scope`, reopens comment-directed reads or unapproved scope expansion.
Disposition: Any bind lean must take the pointer from an approved declared surface (or an explicit human bind onto that surface), then stamp `kind:test` against that bound path.

## In plain English

Through-merge can land the tests that prove a derived clause and still leave that clause with no path on the brief. Complete then stops, because verify:ac will not treat an unbound clause as done. The hole starts when derivation always writes a null path, continues when promote leaves pathless clauses unbound even if file_scope is present, and finishes when stamp refuses a blank path.

The build contract is: keep the ban on lifting a path from issue or comment text, keep unbound clauses fail-closed, and keep merge SHA from counting as smoke/UAT/deploy/observed evidence. Fix the hole by binding an approved file_scope pointer onto the clause before stamp, and make the live stamp writer name the matchAny path so a patch to the unused exact helper cannot pretend to close it.

Confirming this map means the list below is the build contract. The same parent wrote the Stop 1 warrant and this map. The critic comment is the check on the findings. Whether the list covers the three pains stays open until a later critic targets those cites.

**Lean:** the refutation target survives in the form sharpened by comment 5802169107. Derivation-null, promote leave-null for pathless clauses, and stamp refusal on blank path are one hole. The live stamp writer is stampMatchAnyFileEvidence / resolveMatchAnyFilePointer. This map is the bind.

## What happened

Through-merge of #3550 landed the product change in #4972 (`10b73110`) and left `xbrief/active/2026-09-23-3550-bugintakeverify-ac-3398-attestation-enforcement-absent-in-th.xbrief.json` on master. `scope:complete` refused. All five clauses had `artifact_path: null` and no `x-directive/evidence`. The tests that prove those clauses were already in the merge, at `packages/core/src/product-first-done-gate/sentence-floor.test.ts`. Nothing copied that path onto the brief.

Completion then required a hand stamp of `kind: test` onto each plan item. Even after that stamp, `verify:ac` still reported each clause unverifiable: `no artifact path bound`.

## Root cause

Derived clauses are created with no path. `buildClause` in `packages/core/src/verify-ac/clauses.ts` always returns `artifact_path: null`. That was deliberate (#3835): the statement is the issue body plus the comment thread, and lifting a path out of it let a comment choose which file the gate read.

`scope:stamp-evidence` will not fill the hole. `resolveAllowedTestPointer` in `packages/core/src/scope/acceptance-evidence.ts` returns null when `file_scope` is empty or `artifact_path` is blank. #3550's ingested brief had an empty file list and null paths, so the stamp verb wrote nothing. It does not look at tests the pull request added.

`scope:complete` then stops (#3240). It will not treat the merge SHA as evidence for these clauses. #4732 asked to derive `kind: test` from landed tests onto bound clauses. These clauses are never bound, so that slice does not run.

The evidence is missing at derivation. It is not deleted later.

## What completion needs

A through-merge whose tests land for a derived clause must be able to record those tests on that clause without a second manual stamp, and without reading a path out of an issue comment. Unbound clauses must still fail closed (#4385). A merge SHA must still not satisfy smoke, UAT, deploy, or observed behavior (#3240).
